title: RNA Extraction Using Trizol Method Protocol
author: Rui Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.98uh9ww

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve samples from the -80 °C freezer and maintain them on ice.

steps.title: Add Trizol Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Trizol (Ambion® by Life Technologies, Catalog number: 15596-026) to each sample.

substeps.instruction: Add Trizol directly toward the tissue to ensure the tissue is submerged in the solution and not sticking to the tube wall.

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the samples in a fume hood using a hand-held homogenizer (PELLET PESTLE® Cordless Motor, motor cordless, kon 749540-0000, kimble pellet pestle motor, kimble chase company) with autoclaved pellet pestles (part number: 749520-0500, kimble chase company).

substeps.instruction: Locate the tissue between the micro-centrifuge tube well and the tip, squeeze, and turn on the homogenizer.
Change the homogenizer tip for each sample.
Verify that the tissue is completely homogenized.

steps.title: Add GlycoBlue
steps.instruction: Add 1.7 µL GlycoBlue (GlycoBlue TM, Ambion® by Life Technologies) to each sample (representing a 300-fold dilution for a total volume of 500 µL).

steps.title: Prepare Phase Lock Gel
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 30 phase lock gel (PLG) tubes at the maximum speed of the centrifuge for 1 minute.

steps.title: Incubate Samples in PLG
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized samples to the PLG micro-centrifuge tubes and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl phase separation reagent (BCP, molecular biology grade 1-bromo-3-chloropropane, catalog number: BP 151).

substeps.instruction: Shake vigorously by hand for 15 seconds (by placing another micro-centrifuge tube rack on top of the rack containing the samples).
Incubate at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 12,000×g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase into new RNase-free polypropylene micro-centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 0.25 ml 100% isopropanol to the aqueous phase, mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and wash the pellet with 500 µl 75% RNase-free ethanol.

steps.title: Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the ethanol and dry the RNA pellet in a heat block at 55-60 °C, ensuring the RNA is not over-dried.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 20 µl RNase free water and incubate in a heat block set at 55-60 °C for 10-55 minutes.

steps.title: Quantify and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentrations using a NanoDrop.

substeps.instruction: Proceed to downstream application or store at -80°C.
